meta.note: A redesign built from the Retro VHS Night stylesheet: the component inventory and class names come from the source, the values are new.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: The page ground behind everything: a near-black with a trace of violet, like a switched-off CRT. The film grain sits on top of it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the header bar, inputs and poster frames. The default container on screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things lifted off a surface: hovered rows, the top-five rows, trophy cards, poster placeholders.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: the rating rows, the search result list. Also the poster-overlay scrim at 90% alpha.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the resting border of cards. Decorative only; never the only thing marking a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: The resting border of inputs, selects, secondary buttons and the rating input. Meets 3:1 on screen, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on screen, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (14.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, helper copy, the synopsis. On screen, surface and surface-raised (8.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only. On screen, surface and surface-raised (4.85:1 or more). Never for anything the user must read to act.

tokens.name: neon-rose
tokens.usage: The one brand neon. Primary buttons, the header tube line, the active nav item, low ratings. As text it passes on screen, surface and surface-raised (5.5:1 or more). Text ON a rose fill is on-neon, never white.

tokens.name: neon-rose-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hovered primary button fill.

tokens.name: neon-cyan
tokens.usage: Focus rings, links and the Daniel person color. The second neon: it marks where you are, never decoration.

tokens.name: neon-amber
tokens.usage: Mid ratings, the rank-one medal, the Caleb person color, the Family score star.

tokens.name: neon-mint
tokens.usage: High ratings and success toasts.

tokens.name: neon-violet
tokens.usage: The Aiden person color. Not used for UI chrome.

tokens.name: signal-error
tokens.usage: Errors and the destructive Remove button. Orange, so it never reads as the rose brand color; always paired with an icon or the word itself.

tokens.name: medal-bronze
tokens.usage: The rank-three disc in the top five. Rank two uses ink-muted as silver, rank one neon-amber as gold.

tokens.name: on-neon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any neon fill (rose, cyan, amber, mint, violet, signal-error): 6.3:1 on rose, 12.7:1 on amber and cyan.

tokens.name: person-daniel
tokens.usage: Daniel's picker badge, rating initials and trophy badge.

tokens.name: person-jennifer
tokens.usage: Jennifer's picker badge, rating initials and trophy badge.

tokens.name: person-caleb
tokens.usage: Caleb's picker badge, rating initials and trophy badge.

tokens.name: person-aiden
tokens.usage: Aiden's picker badge, rating initials and trophy badge.

tokens.name: rating-low
tokens.usage: Scores below 4 (model.ScoreColorClass). The number is always printed, so color is never the only signal.

tokens.name: rating-mid
tokens.usage: Scores from 4 to below 7.

tokens.name: rating-high
tokens.usage: Scores of 7 and up.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. 10.9:1 or more on every surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: the Trophy Room hero, the login wordmark. Drops to 32px/36px under 480px wide.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Movie titles on the detail page and empty-state headlines. 24px/30px on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and card headings: group titles, Add Movie, Family Ratings, Trophy Room section titles.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The DejaView wordmark in the header only. Carries the rgb-split plus a faint rose glow.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Marty McFly is accidentally sent thirty years into the past.
styles.usage: The synopsis and long reading text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Search for a movie to add it to the next group.
styles.usage: Default text, input values, buttons on phones. Never go below 16px in inputs (iOS zooms).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, card titles set in the sans, person names.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, toast copy, search overviews.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and nav items. Kickers and the marquee moved to the osd style. Always set uppercase; keep to three words.

styles.name: score-lg
styles.usage: The average rating on the detail page and the Family score in the top five.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Rating badges, the rating input, totals.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Year, runtime and counts. Tabular figures. (The header tape counter uses osd.)

styles.name: osd-xl
styles.usage: The big VCR-counter numbers: family totals. Uppercase.

styles.name: osd-lg
styles.usage: The average rating badge, the top-five scores, the login PLAY cue.

styles.name: osd
styles.usage: VCR on-screen display: the header PLAY cue and tape counter, tape labels (TAPE 12), kickers, the marquee. Always uppercase, never below 20px, never more than a few words. Never for sentences, buttons or form labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rating badges; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists; gap in poster grids on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter on phones; poster grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding from 640px up; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 1024px; space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between group sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, the drag handle, poster thumbnails in lists. VHS-label square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toasts, poster cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sections.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Person initials, rank discs, the advantage badge.

shadow.note: Two kinds of light. Glow (a spotlight): only the wordmark, the hovered primary button and the rank-one medal. RGB split (the tape): text-shadow on display type and OSD text, and the chroma edge on hovered posters.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the poster card at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered poster cards and toasts.

tokens.name: glow-rose
tokens.usage: The primary button on hover. Nothing else.

tokens.name: glow-amber
tokens.usage: The rank-one medal only.

tokens.name: rgb-split
tokens.usage: A text-shadow: the misregistered red and cyan ghost of a worn tape. On display-xl, display-lg, the wordmark and osd text only; never on body text or on text over a neon fill.

tokens.name: rgb-split-strong
tokens.usage: The rgb-split at the tape-rewound setting.

tokens.name: chroma-edge
tokens.usage: A box-shadow: the poster card on hover, a red and cyan ghost either side like a tape slipping. Replaces glow-rose on posters.

opacity.note: The tape: scanlines, vignette and grain over the whole screen. Set by the tape-wear class on the page root (tape-clean, tape-worn, tape-rewound); these are the tape-worn defaults.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: The film-grain overlay on the page. 0.05 clean, 0.08 worn, 0.11 rewound.

tokens.name: scanline-opacity
tokens.usage: Dark scanlines on a 3px pitch over the whole screen (x1.4 over posters). They darken one pixel row in three. At 0.18, ink and ink-muted text still clear 5.8:1 even on those rows; neon-rose text and ink-faint dip to about 4:1 on them, so keep rose text 18px bold or larger. 0.10 clean, 0.26 rewound.

tokens.name: vignette-opacity
tokens.usage: The CRT corner darkening. Kept soft so nav and badges at the screen edges stay readable. 0 clean, 0.4 rewound.

tokens.name: disabled-opacity
tokens.usage: Disabled controls while logged out.
